text:
Anna (Product): quick idea: surface a small cost+latency hint next to saved queries so engineers can judge run impact before executing
Samir (Platform): agree. should be sampling-based, not live charge. include sampling_rate and window in the tooltip
Mike R (Console): UI preference: tiny pill in the list row showing cost estimate + latency icon; hover opens compact inspector with more details
Jessie (Eng): backend plan: new endpoint /internal/route_preview?route_id=...&window=1h returns aggregates: median_cost, p95_latency, sample_rate, policy_version, fallbacks
Samir (Platform): include policy_version in both request and response so we can show stale warnings when routing rules have changed
Anna (Product): UX copy for hover: "Estimates are computed from sampled recent traffic for this route. Actuals vary with input length and model selection."
Mike R (Console): accessibility: pill must be keyboard focusable and have aria-expanded for inspector. also color contrast for status chips
Jessie (Eng): implementation notes: batch preview requests for visible rows, cache results for 2m TTL, invalidate on routing policy update or model-pin change
Samir (Platform): preview responses should include sampling_rate so frontend normalizes numbers. backend will emit preview.snapshot_created audit events with snapshot_id
Anna (Product): product question: should we auto-refresh preview after user edits route pin?
Jessie (Eng): auto-refresh after 2s idle or manual refresh button. cap auto refresh to avoid spikes (1 per 5s) and allow opt-out in prefs for big orgs
Mike R (Console): show top 2 fallback models in inspector collapsed by default, with tiny cost/latency numbers for comparison
Samir (Platform): privacy guard: only aggregate metrics, no per-request or PII. enforce RBAC on the endpoint
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: /internal/route_preview v1 -> staging 2024-08-02T09:00Z
Anna (Product): next steps: I'll produce two mock variants (pill-only and pill+inspector), write a short ADR for API shape and safety, and open a ticket
Mike R (Console): ping when mocks ready, will validate density and keyboard flow
Jessie (Eng): will prototype endpoint and sampling normalization; will include sample_rate and policy_version in payload
Samir (Platform): I'll add caching/invalidation hooks and audit plumbing
Anna (Product): thanks team :thumbsup:
